JioHotstar Benchmarks Knowledge Bases for AI Coding Agents
items.summary: JioHotstar evaluated 6 approaches to code retrieval for AI coding agents using SWE, CodeScale Bench, and an internal question-answering harness. Structural search performed well on concrete tasks, whi...
items.description: JioHotstar evaluated 6 approaches to code retrieval for AI coding agents using SWE, CodeScale Bench, and an internal question-answering harness. Structural search performed well on concrete tasks, while semantic retrieval helped with ambiguous requirements. The findings highlight trade-offs in accuracy, token use, and tool design, underscoring the need to match retrieval tools to task types.

items.title: Presentation: Uncorking Queueing Bottlenecks with OpenTelemetry
items.summary: Oli Lane and Julian Wreford share how Gearset replaced guesswork in distributed asynchronous queues with OpenTelemetry tracing. They explain why traditional metrics fall short, how to implement user-c...
items.description: Oli Lane and Julian Wreford share how Gearset replaced guesswork in distributed asynchronous queues with OpenTelemetry tracing. They explain why traditional metrics fall short, how to implement user-centric SLOs based on latency distributions, and share practical debugging tips to help senior developers, software architects, and engineering leaders improve system reliability and team culture.

items.title: Article: The iOS Crash We Could Not Reproduce
items.summary: This article describes the investigation to find the root cause of a production crash in a large-scale iOS consumer app that had no clean stack trace. The crash occurred intermittently and resisted ev...
items.description: This article describes the investigation to find the root cause of a production crash in a large-scale iOS consumer app that had no clean stack trace. The crash occurred intermittently and resisted every local reproduction attempt. The final code change was small, but identifying the root cause required turning a vague SIGBUS report into a controlled set of experiments. By Abhishek Gang Deb
